annotations.title: Make one of the person's schemas public or shared with their team

description: Shares one of the person's own schemas (mine in get_schema) with everyone (public, listed in the community, so other people's sheets and hacks can use it) or with their team (Teams). It can't be undone, since others' sheets and hacks may come to depend on it, so do it only when the person asks for it. Every version is shared, including later ones. Works only if the person turned on "Let my assistant share what it builds" in Settings; otherwise it answers needs_opt_in with where that is.
name: share_schema
title: Make one of the person's schemas public or shared with their team
